title: E-bike & wine tour
text: We had a fantastic day out biking along the coast from Barcelona to Alella with Anka and Fabio. We tasted 2 whites and 2 reds at Bouquet d’Alella, a small winery up in the hill in Alella. Wear bike pants & take snacks as lunch/snacks at the winery are not included in the price.
author: LOAder02

title: Perfect bike ride to winery!
text: So much fun! Lovely bike ride on 17/11 around coast to beautiful family vineyard overlooking Mediterranean. Our guide was super fun and helpful and knowledgeable about the area. Great way to see Barcelona and some of the surrounding area, 10/10 recommend and would even do again.
author: A9056MFclairel

title: Bike review
text: Good pace. Beautiful scenery. Agatha was great! She was informative, friendly and helpful! The wine tasting setting was great!
author: Deborah_E

title: Cheeky winery tour via Barcelona beaches
text:
Great way to see the beaches and local winery   Winery tour and staff great and good local wines to try. Anka, our bike guide, had great tips and recommendations as well as sharing local knowledge and history along the trip. Anka has safety and riders skills at the front of everything she did on the ride to ensure a safe and enjoyable ride. As an experienced rider and racer I know a good rider leader when I see one. 

Well done
author: alexbrew25

title: Wonderful day outside of Barcelona
text:
If you want to do something more than just visiting the city, this is a great way to do something special. You get to see all the beautiful beaches close to Barcelona on the way to Allela. 
Arriving there, the small winery is such a beautiful and fun experience with an amazing location.
author: O2708LUirinak

title: Very nice day trip
text:
A lovely trip to a nearby small town. It was a great way to break out of the city and ride along the sea   The e-bikes made it easy and we returned with plenty of power to spare.  The  tour of the winery was very informative .

Note : The address given on the booking ticket was in error. The meeting place is at the bike shop near Placa Sant Augusti Vell.
author: Will_M

title: Gorgeous ride along the Mediterranean to a beautiful vineyard!
text: We had lovely weather for a bike ride along the beautiful Mediterranean Sea and an amazingly good tour/experience at the vineyard. The bikes were top notch. We’d do this again without question!
author: Jeffrey N
